- pkg_core_warm_start (scope_1): sklearn/ensemble/iforest.py — `warm_start` added to IsolationForest.__init__ (default False), forwarded to BaseBagging via super(), documented in the RandomForestClassifier style.

If you find a defect (e.g. docstring wording not matching the issue text, or BaseBagging parameter naming), request changes and tell me exactly what to fix; I will reopen, repair, republish and ask for a fresh review. Also please confirm whether you want to own any part of scope_2 yourself — otherwise I keep authorship and you stay the independent reviewer.
